items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_det_X_add_C_le
items.type: {n : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] [CommRing α] (A B : Matrix n n α) : (Polynomial.X • A.map ⇑Polynomial.C + B.map ⇑Polynomial.C).det.natDegree ≤ Fintype.card n

items.name: Matrix.charpoly_coeff_eq_sum_minors
items.type: {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : Type v} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (M : Matrix n n R) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card n) : M.charpoly.coeff (Fintype.card n - k) = (-1) ^ k * ∑ s ∈ Finset.powersetCard k Finset.univ, (M.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val).det

items.name: Matrix.pow_sub'
items.type: {n' : Type u_1} [DecidableEq n'] [Fintype n'] {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (A : Matrix n' n' R) {m n : ℕ} (ha : IsUnit A.det) (h : n ≤ m) : A ^ (m - n) = A ^ m * (A ^ n)⁻¹
